facts.fact: ITU states the SMTD data centre, which offers colocation, IaaS, SaaS and backup services, is run by the Société malienne de transmission et de diffusion, described as the company that manages the State's telecommunications infrastructure, and that the Government of Mali set up the two data centres through its agencies.

ITU states the AGETIC, a government agency under the ministry MCENMA, runs a data centre providing hosting (IaaS, SaaS, backup) to the public administration, with a real-time-replicated DR site; the document gives the year only.

systems.owner: Société malienne de transmission et de diffusion (SMTD), state telecoms infrastructure company
systems.tiers: upgrading toward Uptime Tier III (not certified)
